question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Endurance
solution:
The correct answer is **"Indolence."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Endurance"** means the ability to withstand hardship or adversity. (किसी कष्टकारक अथवा कठिन श्रम को लंबे समय तक जारी रखने की क्षमता (बिना असंतोष के); सहनशक्ति, सहिष्‍णुता)

 
 
• **Example**: *He began visiting the gym to build up his strength and **endurance**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Indolence"** is the opposite of** "endurance."**
 
• It means laziness or lack of effort. (आलस्य या प्रयास की कमी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The Venetian nobles abandoned themselves to **indolence**__ and vice.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Patience" is the ability to stay calm and composed in difficult situations. (धैर्य, धीरज, सहनशक्ति; शांत रहना और क्रोध में न आना, (विशेषतः कठिनाई या लंबी प्रतीक्षा के समय))
 
• "Persistence" means continuing to pursue something despite obstacles. (दृढ़ता, आग्रह)
 
• "Tolerance" means the ability to accept or endure something that is different or unpleasant. (सहिष्‍णुता, सहनशीलता)
